dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: I didn't think that something this huge would happen in the village. Everything was quaking! Thank goodness no one was injured...

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Well, a miraculous earthquake in which no one was injured sounds pretty cool, too!

dialogues.speaker: Laume
dialogues.text: Ah, I heard of your heroics during the earthquake. What would you say to an interview?
